requirements.requirement: Structured records value and authoritative existing Record/Records language
requirements.analysis: The producer uses the existing strict Records model and exact semantic schema, retaining the supplied object by deep copy. Empty arrays and 128 short records are admitted; method enum, absolute bounded path and integer status are enforced. The new schema is semantically identical to the unchanged authoritative schema; formatting bytes differ, intentionally not conflated with source-byte identity.

requirements.requirement: Exactly one records Ref; exactly two existing PURE handlers and local preceding STEP_OUTPUT
requirements.analysis: First binding is records/CASE_SLOT_REF records/selector records. The second binding names the first step operations output with null selector. Compilation fixes handler order to normalize-operations then build-map, forbids the parse step and malformed/missing/duplicate/optional/multiref slots. Evaluation uses a local succeeded map and the immediately preceding compiled step, with no global or cross-attempt output lookup. No handler or oracle was added.

requirements.requirement: Explicit version separation, not capture shape reuse
requirements.analysis: PACKAGE_EVAL admit-evaluation-records/evaluate use schema3 and records-v3 evaluator/protocol; RUN create-context/input use schema2, context2, records payload1/provenance records-v1. prepare-composed schema3 maps to composition3, case-input material2 and wire3. Read-only commands remain schema1. Native rejects wire/composition/material/context/kind/composer mismatches.

requirements.requirement: Persistent backend PACKAGE_EVAL admission bound to candidate, owner, group and exact schema
requirements.analysis: Schema and procedure resolve from the pinned frozen selected package, never caller schema/provenance. Admission, PACKAGE_EVAL context and immutable input are inserted in the catalog owner-locked command transaction. capture_material checks input/context/admission group and exact expected context against the selected candidate; rejected or mismatched candidates are refused. RUN material cannot satisfy PACKAGE_EVAL and vice versa.

requirements.requirement: Real qualification then explicit TTY confirmation/Publish, no case substitution in templates
requirements.analysis: PURE calls the two installed handlers and validates outputs, not a fabricated parse or binding receipt. STATIC/PURE publication checks require the same records input Ref, records-v3 evaluator, current compiler/evaluator and exact material/index/closure. Confirmation retains the existing stdin/stderr TTY and explicit yes channel; CAS and exact pins are rechecked after the human wait. Publication/snapshot retain the template; RUN binding is downstream.

requirements.requirement: RUN context/input are separate immutable owner-locked transactions; no caller grants
requirements.analysis: Each command locks the managed owner and stores canonical envelope plus command receipt in its own engine.begin transaction. Input kind, owner, context/schema and SYNTHETIC producer metadata are derived by the backend. Requests reject extra kind/provenance/grant fields; values are copied without sorting/deduplication. Refs are strict and owner/run scoped. The supplied parent PG tests read fresh-process records and exercise transaction rollback after an actual INSERT.

requirements.requirement: Assignment all-or-nothing before dispatch; input selection cannot change preparation or context
requirements.analysis: _prepare holds the existing owner lock across replay lookup, source/input graph validation and all assignment writes. Context version, unassigned context, selection, native preparation, input owner/run, schema and exact slot Ref are checked before insertion. Existing input prefix is preserved and verified byte-exact; assignment records/tasks commit together before any stage. reserve_dispatch revalidates retained stage/current source and deadline before marking dispatch uncertainty.
limits: No independent PostgreSQL/concurrency run by R1. Existing owner-lock semantics were inspected, not certified as a new records overlap/crash protocol.

requirements.requirement: BoundProcedure and all MethodRequirements before Brief; metadata before Brief, composition after
requirements.analysis: PromptBundle metadata is in the context prefix. Binding replaces only the declared first slot source and clears materialized slots; it preserves the preceding-step binding and template source. A bound-procedure and the full requirement list, including required=false, precede task-brief construction. Composition follows the completed Brief and carries the structured input plus original schema bytes. Validation compares exact assignment/requirement references and rejects an omitted requirement.

requirements.requirement: Independent byte ceilings, schema/source binding and native pre-constructor refusal
requirements.analysis: Cardinality is distinct from schema8192, input envelope8192, graph65536 and native frame32768. Raw schema is strict UTF-8, exact semantic shape, canonical base64, and matched to selected file path/hash/size. Native records validation checks the language independently rather than importing/running handlers. Valid empty/Unicode/128-short inputs and resealed negative cases pass the scoped suite. Oversized records may legally be refused below the cardinality limit, with no truncation or ceiling expansion.

requirements.requirement: Idempotency/conflict/restart readback, no PURE rerun or slot rebinding
requirements.analysis: Matching canonical request digests replay committed refs/records; differing payloads conflict. Managed replay bypasses _build/current_source while retained validation checks exact material without new binding. Qualification replay reads pinned material and stored outputs without evaluate_pure; records dependency-bearing compilation is refused before the dependency qualification execution path. Parent tests patch defining handler/evaluator/build modules, not only a consumer alias, and use fresh CLI processes for readback.
limits: Fresh-process command readback is not a physical DB/server restart, crash-cut or ACK-loss measurement.

findings.cause: records_schema validates UTF-8/BOM then JSON semantics but does not reject raw C0/C1 controls. JSON permits CR as insignificant whitespace, so it disappears from semantic comparison. Native _capture_material calls raw_text on the retained raw schema and rejects CR.

Static tracing identifies potential qualification of material later rejected by the native document prerequisite. PostgreSQL persistence of this negative was not executed. No claim of a RUN reservation or constructor side effect: the ordinary integrated RUN path has an earlier mitigating document check.
findings.mitigation_verified: native_preparation_models.document refuses identical CR/CRLF source. All retained package files pass this check in native preparation and managed_composition.selected_skills:104-118; _verify_compositions:836-855 reuses selected_skills before _prepare writes. Thus the standalone validator discrepancy does not establish a reachable native dispatch/constructor bypass.
findings.minimal_fix: In new records_schema only, reject raw controls with the same strict UTF-8/BOM/LF-TAB policy as the existing document/raw_text validators BEFORE semantic JSON parsing; retain bytes without normalization. Add matching LF/TAB positives and CR/CRLF negatives through compiler, PACKAGE_EVAL and same-byte API/native consumers; prove no new persisted admission/input/evaluation/reservation rows on the real PG path. Do not relax native validation or modify historical capture acceptance.
